content: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 189b-23a (as printed; the next work begins on f. 223b, so the end is presumably f. 223a) carries the Tamhīd al-Qawāʿid, copied in Shiraz on 2 Dhū l-Qaʿda 830/25 August 1427; no catalogue reference is printed. The next listed copy is MS Sipahsālār 2930/9 ff. 141-277 (29 Rabīʿ I 845/17 August 1441, titled al-Shahīd fī Sharḥ Risālat al-Tawḥīd).
